published_commit_note: published_commit is the commit that carried the previous freeze's mint onto the published branch (for pass-59, the v2.31 close). It is NOT the same object as anchor_commit, which names this pass's apply commit; both resolve on the public branch. This field went four passes stale before pass-53 because nothing gates it - recompute it at every mint, and never assume anchor and published are the same commit.
